scope: Method, aggregate baseline, and 15 sampled synthetic source/label/review triples; no engine modification

findings.finding: 90 accepted reviews establish schema and citation validity, not 90 correct editorial decisions. Clean diagnosis is 40/40; final unchanged is 39/40.
F07, F14, H17, and H23 contain genuine missing operational propositions, but their proposed deliverables may differ from a safe narrower edit to the current draft.
A11, A12, H20, and G15 depend partly on a future deliverable or intentional open ending; H15 proposes a desk-script edit whose source text is absent.
SAFE_WITH_SOURCE cannot certify a missing proposition is answerable; no final rewrite was attempted, so unsafe factual changes cannot be inferred.
D06 has distributed repetition, while D02's substantive label depends on the desired document outcome; number of jobs alone does not establish global coupling.

acceptedInterpretation: Keep scope, feasibility, and execution separate; treat first-review labels as challenged editorial judgments; defer a new contract until an explicit requested deliverable is included in development inputs.
